name: mathweaver-mcp
description: MathWeaver MCP server exposing Z3 verification tools from the CounterExampleForge.

tools.name: check_group_axioms
tools.description: Check whether a Cayley table defines a group using Z3. Verifies closure, associativity, identity element and inverses. Returns success=True with a counter-example when any axiom is violated.

table.description: Cayley table: an n x n matrix of integers, each entry in the range [0, n). Row i, column j gives the result of the binary operation applied to (i, j).

tools.name: verify_associativity
tools.description: Verify associativity of a binary operation given as a Cayley table using Z3. Returns success=True with the violating triple when associativity fails.

table.description: Cayley table: an n x n matrix of integers, each entry in the range [0, n). Row i, column j gives the result of the binary operation applied to (i, j).

tools.name: check_commutativity
tools.description: Check commutativity (Abelian property) of a binary operation given as a Cayley table using Z3. Returns success=True with the violating pair when commutativity fails.

table.description: Cayley table: an n x n matrix of integers, each entry in the range [0, n). Row i, column j gives the result of the binary operation applied to (i, j).
